plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked Scoville dilution & hydrophobic solubility chart from Wilbur Scoville (May 1912, J. Am. Pharm. Assoc. 1: 453–454) and E. K. Nelson (1919) compares bell pepper (0 SHU), jalapeño (~5,000 SHU), cayenne (~40,000 SHU), habanero (~300,000 SHU), and pure capsaicin (16,000,000 SHU) alongside casein micelles in milk stripping hydrophobic capsaicin off nerve membranes.

teach_overlay.scale: drinking cold water on a chili burn is like trying to wash motor oil off your hands with plain water — while milk's casein proteins act like tiny detergent sponges that lift the greasy capsaicin molecule off your nerves
